title: NCAA: Aurigue stands tall as Lyceum hands Mapua another heartbreak
summary: Lance Aurigue stood tall as Lyceum of the Philippines University outlasted Mapua University, 88-87, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Monday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
